none: PAS NLM-888C9A: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), an irregular fallen horseman issue of 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: bust right; hair and eyebrow of a larger image but occupying most of this small flan. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 9mm, Weight: 0.42gms, die axis: probably 6
